project.name: MoreNumTegra
project.canonical_ref_rule: resolve live main before current-state claims

objective.text: Operate and evolve a mobile-first Tegra real-estate discovery and Search-to-Lead experience with verified product truth, organic discoverability, conversion, measurement and controlled paid-media readiness.

progress.warning: Program progress is not the same as V1 production readiness. Commercial V1 is already operational.

current.next_safe_action: Complete schema/consistency validation, obtain the required independent exact-head documentation audit, adjudicate any P0/P1 findings, and then proceed only through separately authorized PR lifecycle gates. Do not perform runtime, tracking, Vercel, Green, DNS, Search Console, Ads or spend mutation from this work package.

decomposition_contract.atomic_rule: Do not create children when additional decomposition would not improve execution visibility or would retrospectively invent accepted historical detail.
decomposition_contract.rollup_rule: Parent hours equal sum of immediate children when decomposed; never double-count parent plus descendants.
decomposition_contract.percent_rule: program_weight_percent is hours/1240; phase_weight_percent is node hours/phase hours; parent_weight_percent is child hours/parent hours. Lifecycle completion/accepted percentages must come from CURRENT_PROGRAM_STATE.json, not the structural graph.
decomposition_contract.authorization_rule: PLANNED WBS != AUTHORIZED EXECUTION. Child planning nodes inherit project governance and require the applicable Product Authority gate.
